law: Every committed Playwright baseline under packages/showroom/e2e belongs to one note here, keyed by the spec that owns its __screenshots__ folder. The note pins the count and a sha256 of the set (path and bytes, sorted), so a baseline without a note, or a set regenerated before it expires, is red. Checked by packages/core/scripts/check/evidence/tests-through-the-door.

expiries.reference-identity-approved: The owner picks the BitHire reference identity (D-30, WO-DER-07; deferred to the branding stage by the owner on 2026-09-10). Until then these sets are pre-migration captures that freeze current paint, hardcodes included. After the pick each set is regenerated once and its note is replaced.
